product_one_liner.value: Paddle is an all-in-one merchant-of-record payments and billing platform that helps SaaS, mobile app, AI, and other digital-product companies sell globally, handling checkout, subscriptions, tax compliance, fraud protection, and retention.
product_one_liner.notes: Paddle’s developer documentation describes it as an all-in-one merchant of record for modern SaaS, mobile app, AI, and digital product companies, with checkout, subscriptions, tax compliance, metrics, fraud protection, and retention tools.

pricing_page.notes: Paddle’s public pricing page lists its pay-as-you-go plan and a transaction price, so a public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Paddle’s customer stories page names MacPaw and Fortinet among its customers. | named_customers.0: The Paddle customer stories page names MacPaw as a customer and links to its story. | named_customers.1: The Paddle customer stories page names Fortinet in its customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: The company directory reports Paddle employs between 201 and 500 people, which matches the permitted band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Paddle’s company profile lists London, England, United Kingdom as its locality; the city component is London. | hq_country: Paddle’s LinkedIn company profile identifies its location as London, England, United Kingdom, supporting United Kingdom as the headquarters country.

founded_year.notes: The Paddle portfolio profile states it was founded in 2012; Companies House independently shows Paddle.com Market Limited was incorporated in August 2012.

eng_blog.notes: Paddle identifies this as its product and engineering team blog. Its index includes multiple technical engineering posts, including the Go microservices architecture article and payment-routing engineering deep dives, meeting the two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: Paddle maintains a public developer documentation portal with product explanations, quickstarts, and documentation index links, satisfying the several-articles requirement.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Paddle’s live job listings include a Senior AI Engineer and a Head of Data Science posting, both matching the specified AI/ML/data-science titles.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Paddle’s Trust Center compliance section names SOC 2, PCI DSS 4.0.1, and GDPR. Those are the requested named items; CCPA is not included because it is outside the requested list. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly lists SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly lists PCI DSS 4.0.1. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly lists GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest reported capital event is the May 2026 issuance of unsecured convertible loan notes, a convertible debt financing. | funding_date: The reported issuance date is 29 May 2026, which formats as 2026-05. | funding_amount_usd: The accounts summary reports that Paddle issued convertible loan notes with aggregate principal of US$25 million on 29 May 2026; the exchange notice independently identifies Paddle’s USD 25 million 2026 convertible notes.

raised_18mo.notes: The documented $25 million convertible-note issuance occurred in May 2026, inside the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Paddle’s live job listing is titled Business Development Representative and gives an application link; this meets the requested BDR criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: Paddle’s announcement dated October 20, 2026 says it launched the AI Toolkit and announced native Usage-Based Billing, both within the six-month window preceding November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Paddle lifecycle-marketing job posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as an engagement tool used with its data warehouse. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting explicitly names HubSpot as an engagement tool.
